<div class="card-body">
'''X-wing''' is a [[Light]] [[Starship]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">Ｘウイング</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">能力値１の専属パイロットが乗っている。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-146o-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">インコム社のＴ－６５型。亡命した設計チームによって同盟軍に配備された。全長１２．５ｍ。攻撃範囲をより広くするために、Ｘ型に翼を展開する。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' X-wing.

'''Card text:''' Has a permanent pilot with ability 1.

'''Lore:''' Incom's T-65 model. Its defecting design team supplied it to the Alliance. It is 12.5 meters long. The wings spread into an X to broaden its attack coverage.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[X-wing]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
